title: AI-Based Horse Identification and Gait Analysis.
summary: AIforPet describes real-world pilots of horse identification and gait analysis, aiming to improve animal management and welfare.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The system analyzes horse identity and gait information. AIforPet reports pilot feasibility and user acceptance, and plans broader datasets covering more breeds, ages, and activities. Better horse care and sustainable livestock management are intended benefits, without a quantified management or welfare change.
purpose: Support horse identification and health-related gait assessment.

ratings.reason: Pilot feasibility and user acceptance are reported, but improvements in management performance remain unquantified.
Horse welfare and sustainable livestock benefits remain potential.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 12: AI-Based Horse Identification and Gait Analysis.

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: AI horse identification and gait analysis enter pilot testing
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
